cases.scenario: healthy two-lane bring-up spine with long frames, zero backpressure, and full scoreboard
cases.primary_checks: `wr_hdr==rd_hdr`, `wr_shd==rd_shd`, `wr_hit==rd_hit`, no `ft_drop_*` beats, `unexplained=0` per lane

cases.scenario: sparse/boundary subheader-byte timestamp values exercising the `extend_subheader_ts` wrap predicate (`shd_byte < running_ts[11:4]`)
cases.primary_checks: reconstructed 48-bit timestamp matches reference for both no-wrap and wrap samples; no ordering inversion on egress

cases.scenario: mixed empty and non-empty subheader sequence inside one frame on the healthy path
cases.primary_checks: zero-hit subheaders still advance `running_shd_cnt`; data-bearing subheaders carry the correct `hit_cnt` body length

cases.scenario: native FEB whole-frame packet contract with monitor-side reconstruction from real DUT pins
cases.primary_checks: preamble/body/trailer framing, SOP on K285 beat, EOP on K284 beat, one ticket per frame closure

cases.scenario: lane 0 produces hits while lane 1 emits legal empty-frame cadence only
cases.primary_checks: lane 0 ledger closes normally, lane 1 produces zero hits and non-zero header/subheader counters

cases.scenario: mirror of B005 with lane 1 as the producer and lane 0 on empty-frame cadence
cases.primary_checks: lane 1 ledger closes normally, lane 0 empty-lane accounting clean

cases.scenario: denser single-lane subheader and hit packing without leaving the healthy no-drop path
cases.primary_checks: lane ledger closes, `ft_drop_*=0`, basic presenter `resident_hold` never engaged

cases.scenario: CSR[0x000] UID readback returns literal `UID_CONST = 0x4F50514D` ("OPQM") on every read regardless of prior run activity
cases.primary_checks: UID stable across reset, traffic-active, and post-terminate reads; catches accidental writability or mux swap with META

cases.scenario: CSR[0x001] META with `meta_sel = 2'b00` (VERSION) returns `pack_version_func(major, minor, patch, build)` bit layout
cases.primary_checks: META word reads `{major[31:24], minor[23:16], patch[15:12], build[11:0]}`; catches bit-field packing regression in `pack_version_word`

cases.scenario: CSR[0x001] META with `meta_sel = 2'b01` (DATE) returns `VERSION_DATE` generic
cases.primary_checks: META reads the 32-bit date integer; catches a stale META mux leftover after meta_sel write

cases.scenario: CSR[0x001] META with `meta_sel = 2'b10` (GIT) returns `VERSION_GIT` hash
cases.primary_checks: META reads git hash constant; catches mis-decoded 2-bit selector

cases.scenario: CSR[0x001] META with `meta_sel = 2'b11` (INSTANCE) returns `INSTANCE_ID`
cases.primary_checks: META reads instance id; catches default-branch fallthrough when other selectors are live

cases.scenario: CSR[0x002] LANE_MASK reset default = 0 (every lane effective, since `lane_mask_effective = ~csr.lane_mask` after pruning)
cases.primary_checks: initial LANE_MASK read = 0; `STATUS[19]` = OR of `lane_mask_effective` = 1; catches a reset literal regression

cases.scenario: CSR[0x002] LANE_MASK full-write RW: set bit[0]=1 to gate lane 0, read back, and verify lane 0 ingress is silently dropped at the parser boundary
cases.primary_checks: after write, lane 0 `wr_hdr_cnt` freezes; lane 1 counters continue; catches mask not reaching `u_ingress_parser[0]` enable

cases.scenario: CSR[0x003] CTRL bit[0] `soft_reset_request` self-clears within one idle cycle after host write-1
cases.primary_checks: write CTRL=1, readback may be 1 once, then settles to 0 within one CSR poll; catches a missing self-clear

cases.scenario: CSR[0x003] CTRL full-32-bit writable surface: write 0xFFFF_FFFF and verify only the defined bits latch; reserved bits read 0
cases.primary_checks: readback `(CTRL & ~DEFINED_MASK) == 0`; catches accidental mapping of spare bits

cases.scenario: CSR[0x004] STATUS[16] = `page_allocator_active` mirrors the u_page_allocator activity handshake
cases.primary_checks: observe bit[16]=1 while a block is being written, =0 otherwise; catches wrong signal tap

cases.scenario: CSR[0x004] STATUS[17] = `arbiter_active` mirrors the B2P arbiter lock path
cases.primary_checks: observe bit[17]=1 while `ARBITER_LOCKED`, 0 in `ARBITER_IDLE`; catches arbiter_active tied to wrong state

cases.scenario: CSR[0x004] STATUS[18] = `aso_egress_valid` mirrors the basic presenter valid stream
cases.primary_checks: bit[18] high-coverage aligns with `aso_*_valid` beats; catches tap regressed to `_ready`

cases.scenario: CSR[0x004] STATUS[19] = OR of `lane_mask_effective` per lane
cases.primary_checks: toggling LANE_MASK to `{1,1}` drops bit[19] to 0; catches AND/OR swap

cases.scenario: CSR[0x004] STATUS[23:20] = `N_LANE` generic integer
cases.primary_checks: read STATUS>>20 == OPQ_N_LANE; catches an N_LANE constant frozen at build-time wrong value

cases.scenario: CSR[0x005] CAP returns the static capability word (N_LANE, N_SHD, TICKET_FIFO_DEPTH, PAGE_RAM_DEPTH encoded)
cases.primary_checks: readback equals expected packed word for `default_p2_s256_t256_r65536` build; catches CAP bit-ordering regression

cases.scenario: CSR[0x008] FT_WR_HDR global counter matches sum of per-lane `wr_hdr` across all lanes at any poll point
cases.primary_checks: global == Σ per-lane; catches mis-adder or race between global and lane counters

cases.scenario: CSR[0x009] FT_WR_SHD global counter matches sum of per-lane `wr_shd`
cases.primary_checks: global == Σ per-lane; catches same adder regression on subheader axis

cases.scenario: CSR[0x00A] FT_WR_HIT global counter matches sum of per-lane `wr_hit`
cases.primary_checks: global == Σ per-lane; catches adder regression on hit axis

cases.scenario: CSR[0x00B] FT_RD_HDR global counter increments exactly once per retired header via the basic presenter's `PRESENTING -> WAIT_FOR_COMPLETE` retirement path
cases.primary_checks: FT_RD_HDR delta over a drained frame equals the number of retired headers; catches missed retirement pulse

cases.scenario: CSR[0x00C] FT_RD_SHD global counter increments exactly once per retired subheader
cases.primary_checks: delta equals retired subheader count; catches double-count when `retire_pending` is asserted with `EGRESS_DELAY` alignment

cases.scenario: CSR[0x00D] FT_RD_HIT global counter increments exactly once per retired hit
cases.primary_checks: delta equals retired hit count; catches off-by-one in retire-pending counter in the EGRESS_DELAY pipeline

cases.scenario: CSR[0x00E]/[0x00F]/[0x010] FT_DROP_HDR/SHD/HIT all read 0 on any healthy no-drop run
cases.primary_checks: three drop counters flat at 0 for B001-B007; catches a phantom drop pulse

cases.scenario: CSR lane region stride: lane `i` block sits at `CSR_LANE_REGION_BASE + i*0x010` (base 0x040) and each lane word at `+0x0..+0xF` is disjoint from global 0x000-0x010
cases.primary_checks: crafted walk across `i=0..N_LANE-1` reads distinct live counters; catches a mis-sized stride constant

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0x0 (WR_HDR) reflects the per-lane `wr_hdr` counter driven out of `u_ingress_parser[i]`
cases.primary_checks: per-lane count equals number of K285 preamble beats accepted on that lane; catches wrong signal taped to this offset

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0x1 (WR_SHD) reflects per-lane `wr_shd` (K237 subheader beats accepted)
cases.primary_checks: per-lane count equals subheader beats; catches K237 miscount at parser boundary

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0x2 (WR_HIT) reflects per-lane `wr_hit`
cases.primary_checks: per-lane count equals hit beats forwarded into the lane body path; catches hit count polluted by header/subheader beats

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0x3 (RD_HDR) reflects retirement at the presenter, one pulse per retired header for this lane
cases.primary_checks: retired header count equals lane's originated-frame count on a clean drain; catches RD_HDR plumbed to the wrong lane tap

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0x4 (RD_SHD) reflects retired subheader count for this lane
cases.primary_checks: retired subheader count equals lane-originated subheader count; catches RD_SHD tap regression

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0x5 (RD_HIT) reflects retired hit count for this lane
cases.primary_checks: retired hit count equals ingress hit count on the healthy path; catches RD_HIT tap regression

cases.scenario: lane[i] offsets +0x6/+0x7/+0x8 (DROP_HDR/SHD/HIT) all stay 0 on the healthy path
cases.primary_checks: per-lane drop counters flat; catches a lane-local drop pulse leaking into the healthy path

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0x9 (LANE_CREDIT_VISIBLE) reflects `lane_credit_visible_word(i)` — the current lane-FIFO free credit exposed to hosts
cases.primary_checks: at quiescence the word reads `LANE_FIFO_MAX_CREDIT = 1022`; catches a stale credit latch

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0xA (TICKET_CREDIT_VISIBLE) reflects `ticket_credit_visible_word(i)`
cases.primary_checks: at quiescence reads `TICKET_FIFO_MAX_CREDIT = 255`; catches credit stuck after one frame

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0xB (DRR_ALLOWANCE) defaults to `DRR_DEFAULT_ALLOWANCE = 256` at reset
cases.primary_checks: readback at reset == 256 on every active lane; catches a default literal regression

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0xB (DRR_ALLOWANCE) is RW; write 0x000 (zero allowance) then read back
cases.primary_checks: writable round-trip; and the lane defers every grant until reload (tested functionally in DV_CROSS); catches accidental RO flag

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0xB (DRR_ALLOWANCE) rejects values > `QUANTUM_MAX = 0x3ff` via width clamp or range check
cases.primary_checks: write 0x7FFF and read back == 0x3FF (or whichever clamp the RTL applies); catches a missing clamp

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0xC (DRR_QUANTUM) exposes the current running quantum after `sat_add_quantum` application
cases.primary_checks: in idle-lane window the quantum equals programmed allowance; catches wrong quantum mirror

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0xD (DRR_GRANT_CNT) increments once per arbiter grant that landed on this lane in the B2P `ARBITER_LOCKED` state
cases.primary_checks: count == number of grant events seen by `u_block_path`; catches double-count on re-grant

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0xE (DRR_BEAT_CNT) counts block-path beats actually written (not just grants)
cases.primary_checks: beat count == subheader+hit beats written into page_ram under the lane's grant; catches beat miscount on aborted writes

cases.scenario: lane[i] offset +0xF (DRR_DEFER_CNT) increments once per defer event (lane had hits but zero allowance)
cases.primary_checks: matches number of forced defers across a run with programmed zero-allowance windows; catches defer miscount

cases.scenario: CSR write to a reserved lane[i]+0x(10..1F) offset is ignored (within-region but out-of-stride)
cases.primary_checks: readback unchanged; catches a stray assignment bleeding into reserved words

cases.scenario: CSR write to an unmapped global offset 0x011..0x03F is ignored
cases.primary_checks: readback = default (0) and waitrequest handshake still completes; catches bus hang on undecoded offsets

cases.scenario: CSR `avs_csr_waitrequest` drops to 0 exactly one cycle after any read or write, returns to 1 in idle
cases.primary_checks: observe waitrequest waveform across a 3-beat CSR sequence; catches a stuck waitrequest that would hang the host hub

cases.scenario: CSR uses 9-bit word-addressed bus `avs_csr_address[8:0]`; byte addresses from host must be divided by 4 to land on the correct word
cases.primary_checks: a word address decode of 0x008 returns FT_WR_HDR; catches byte/word address confusion at the bus boundary

cases.scenario: ingress K285 preamble recognition: `is_preamble_word()` returns 1 only when `data[7:0]=0x9C` AND `data[35:32]=4'b0001` (datak nibble)
cases.primary_checks: inject K285 on data[7:0] with datak=0001 and verify `wr_hdr` increments; catches K-char byte swap

cases.scenario: ingress K237 subheader recognition: `is_subheader_word()` returns 1 only when `data[7:0]=0xF7` AND `data[35:32]=4'b0001`
cases.primary_checks: inject K237 with datak=0001 and verify `wr_shd` increments; catches K237 byte swap

cases.scenario: ingress K284 trailer recognition: `is_trailer_word()` returns 1 only when `data[7:0]=0xBC` AND `data[35:32]=4'b0001`
cases.primary_checks: inject K284 and verify the ingress parser exits to IDLE via frame closure; catches trailer miscount

cases.scenario: ingress rejects a fake K285 where `datak` bits are 4'b0000 (data-valued 0x9C treated as normal data)
cases.primary_checks: the parser does NOT increment wr_hdr nor leave IDLE; catches datak-unaware preamble match

cases.scenario: ingress rejects a fake K237 where `datak` bits are 4'b0000
cases.primary_checks: wr_shd does not increment; catches datak-unaware subheader match

cases.scenario: ingress rejects a fake K284 where `datak` bits are 4'b0000
cases.primary_checks: parser stays in its current state; catches datak-unaware trailer match

cases.scenario: ingress parser `INGRESS_PARSER_IDLE -> UPDATE_HEADER_TS` on legal K285 preamble beat
cases.primary_checks: FSM debug tap shows one-cycle transition; catches premature transition on any non-preamble beat

cases.scenario: ingress parser 4-beat header flow: captures `running_ts` on beat 1, `frame_ts_base` on beat 2, `pkg_cnt` on beat 3, and `running_shd_cnt + hit_cnt` on beat 4 before entering WR_HITS
cases.primary_checks: scoreboard snapshot of captured fields matches injected header; catches off-by-one field slicing

cases.scenario: ingress parser transitions `UPDATE_HEADER_TS -> WR_HITS` only after `send_ts` capture on beat 4
cases.primary_checks: verify no WR_HITS entry before 4-beat header completion; catches premature body-state transition

cases.scenario: ingress parser `WR_HITS -> WR_HITS` loops on hit beats until a K237 subheader or K284 trailer arrives
cases.primary_checks: parser debug tap shows sustained WR_HITS across hit beats; catches a spurious exit

cases.scenario: ingress parser `WR_HITS -> UPDATE_HEADER_TS` on a mid-frame K237 subheader for the next subheader body
cases.primary_checks: verify subheader beat is captured, body continues in WR_HITS; catches subheader being misclassified as header

cases.scenario: ingress parser `WR_HITS -> IDLE` on legal K284 trailer beat and the frame is closed with a ticket write
cases.primary_checks: one ticket write per K284 observed; catches missed ticket closure

cases.scenario: ingress parser `alert_eop` flag latches on K284 and clears after the ticket write is retired (SVA `p_alert_eop_clears_after_ticket_write`)
cases.primary_checks: flag falls within N cycles of ticket-fifo write pulse; catches a stuck alert_eop

cases.scenario: ingress parser `alert_sop` flag latches on K285 and clears inside the 4-beat header cycle
cases.primary_checks: flag falls before entry into WR_HITS; catches stuck alert_sop across frames

cases.scenario: subheader TS reconstruction no-wrap case: `shd_byte >= running_ts[11:4]`
cases.primary_checks: `extend_subheader_ts = {running_ts[47:12], shd_byte, 4'b0000}`; catches sign/extend miscue

cases.scenario: subheader TS reconstruction wrap case: `shd_byte < running_ts[11:4]`
cases.primary_checks: reconstructed TS increments `running_ts[47:12]` by 1 before stitching `shd_byte`; catches missed wrap predicate

cases.scenario: subheader TS reconstruction at the low boundary `shd_byte=0x00` with `running_ts[11:4]=0x00`
cases.primary_checks: no-wrap branch taken; reconstructed TS lower 12 bits = 0x000; catches default-branch fallthrough

cases.scenario: subheader TS reconstruction at the high boundary `shd_byte=0xFF` with `running_ts[11:4]=0x00`
cases.primary_checks: no-wrap branch taken; catches a wrap path false-firing on high shd_byte

cases.scenario: subheader TS reconstruction at the exact-match boundary `shd_byte == running_ts[11:4]`
cases.primary_checks: no-wrap branch taken per the `<` predicate; catches off-by-one on wrap compare

cases.scenario: subheader TS reconstruction at `shd_byte = running_ts[11:4] - 1`
cases.primary_checks: wrap branch taken; catches wrap missed by one

cases.scenario: frame header `pkg_cnt` field is captured unchanged in the ticket `TICKET_FEB_ID` composite, preserving FEB identity through to egress
cases.primary_checks: egress ticket FEB_ID equals ingress pkg_cnt; catches a field swap

cases.scenario: frame header `send_ts` field is captured into `TICKET_FRAME_TS` at beat 4
cases.primary_checks: egress frame_ts equals ingress send_ts; catches TICKET_FRAME_TS tap regression

cases.scenario: frame header `running_shd_cnt` at beat 4 equals the promised subheader count for the frame
cases.primary_checks: egress `TICKET_N_SUBH` matches the promised count; catches miscount when frame has exactly one subheader

cases.scenario: frame header `hit_cnt` at beat 4 equals the promised hit count for the frame
cases.primary_checks: egress `TICKET_N_HIT` matches the promised count; catches hit_cnt being zero-extended wrong

cases.scenario: page allocator returns one free handle per frame opening and recycles it on frame close
cases.primary_checks: free-handle count returns to the initial pool between frames; catches leaked handle

cases.scenario: page allocator `o_n_free_handle` is visible via the STATUS bit[16] and the handle FIFO depth = `HANDLE_FIFO_DEPTH = 64` is never exceeded
cases.primary_checks: monitor of handle FIFO usedw <= 64; catches handle FIFO overrun

cases.scenario: page allocator walks `page_ram_wptr` monotonically across a frame body until a frame-close beats lands a `block_len` write into `TICKET_BLOCK_LEN`
cases.primary_checks: `TICKET_BLOCK_LEN` = final beat count; catches ticket length lagging real writes

cases.scenario: page allocator free-pointer equals `OPQ_PAGE_RAM_DEPTH = 65536` at reset
cases.primary_checks: pre-traffic poll returns the full depth; catches allocator reset regression

cases.scenario: page allocator does not advance free-pointer on aborted block writes (BLOCK_MOVER_ABORT_WRITE_BLK path)
cases.primary_checks: after a forced abort the free-pointer matches the pre-abort value; catches accounting leak on abort

cases.scenario: page allocator emits the ticket `TICKET_LANE_RD_OFST` pointing at the base of the just-written block
cases.primary_checks: basic presenter reads from the declared offset exactly; catches offset field swap

cases.scenario: block mover `BLOCK_MOVER_IDLE -> PREP` on the arbiter `ARBITER_LOCKED` grant for this lane
cases.primary_checks: FSM debug tap shows the transition only on grant; catches a spurious PREP entry

cases.scenario: block mover `PREP -> WRITE_BLK` once the handle FIFO returns a page handle
cases.primary_checks: FSM debug shows transition only after handle pop; catches premature WRITE_BLK

cases.scenario: block mover `WRITE_BLK -> IDLE` on last beat of a legal frame body with a ticket write at the same cycle
cases.primary_checks: one ticket per block observed; catches ticket omission

cases.scenario: block mover `WRITE_BLK -> ABORT_WRITE_BLK` when the lane FIFO reports an integrity error (BUG-018 historical)
cases.primary_checks: FSM takes the abort leg; `TICKET_ALT_EOP_LOC` records the alternate EOP; catches abort leg missed on integrity fault

cases.scenario: block mover `ABORT_WRITE_BLK -> RESET` releases the page back to the allocator without advancing `page_ram_wptr`
cases.primary_checks: allocator pointer unchanged after abort; catches pointer leak on abort (SVA `p_abort_returns_credit`)

cases.scenario: block mover `RESET -> IDLE` after the abort credit is returned
cases.primary_checks: FSM exits RESET within N cycles; catches stuck RESET

cases.scenario: B2P arbiter `ARBITER_IDLE -> LOCKING` on first grant request
cases.primary_checks: transition observed once per frame; catches LOCKING entry missed

cases.scenario: B2P arbiter `LOCKING -> LOCKED` after the grant fans out to the selected lane's block mover
cases.primary_checks: `arbiter_active` STATUS bit[17] rises; catches LOCKED never reached

cases.scenario: B2P arbiter `LOCKED -> ARBITER_IDLE` on block completion (last beat written)
cases.primary_checks: bit[17] falls within 1 cycle of block completion; catches stuck LOCKED

cases.scenario: B2P arbiter uses `rr_grant` with a rotating `priority_mask` per grant event
cases.primary_checks: successive grants favor the next lane in the rotation; catches stuck priority_mask

cases.scenario: B2P arbiter grants only lanes whose `lane_credit_visible > 0` AND `ticket_credit_visible > 0`
cases.primary_checks: lanes with either credit at 0 get zero grants in that window; catches credit gate omission

cases.scenario: B2P arbiter rejects a lane whose `lane_mask_effective` bit is cleared
cases.primary_checks: masked lane sees no grants; catches mask gate bypass

cases.scenario: DRR default service on one lane uses `DRR_DEFAULT_ALLOWANCE = 256` quantum before the mover yields
cases.primary_checks: on the default build the lane moves exactly 256 beats before yielding; catches wrong default allowance

cases.scenario: DRR `sat_add_quantum` saturates at `QUANTUM_MAX = 0x3ff` on repeated defers
cases.primary_checks: after multiple defers the quantum shown at lane[i]+0xC equals 0x3FF; catches saturation miss

cases.scenario: DRR zero-defer window: on a healthy steady-state frame the `drr_defer_cnt` stays 0
cases.primary_checks: no defer events in B001-B007 equivalent traffic; catches spurious defers on healthy path

cases.scenario: DRR grant count delta equals the number of frames served on that lane across the window (one grant per frame)
cases.primary_checks: `drr_grant_cnt` delta == frame count; catches grant per-beat counting

cases.scenario: DRR beat count delta equals subheader+hit beats moved across the window
cases.primary_checks: `drr_beat_cnt` delta == moved beats; catches header beats counted as DRR beats

cases.scenario: DRR allowance reload via `drr_allowance_reload_i` refreshes the programmed allowance at the start of each subframe
cases.primary_checks: after reload the running quantum resets; catches a stale quantum surviving reload

cases.scenario: basic presenter `FTABLE_PRESENTER_IDLE -> WAIT_FOR_COMPLETE` on ticket arrival
cases.primary_checks: FSM tap shows transition one cycle after ticket_fifo write; catches missed transition

cases.scenario: basic presenter `WAIT_FOR_COMPLETE -> PRESENTING` once page_ram has all beats of the frame committed
cases.primary_checks: latency from ticket to first egress beat bounded by `EGRESS_DELAY = 3`; catches early PRESENTING entry

cases.scenario: basic presenter `PRESENTING -> WAIT_FOR_COMPLETE` after frame retirement (one per frame)
cases.primary_checks: retirement pulse observed; catches a stuck PRESENTING

cases.scenario: basic presenter `PRESENTING -> RESET` on external reset and reset clears meta table pointers (meta_wptr/rptr), retire_pending, and resident_hold
cases.primary_checks: all cleared after reset exits; catches residual meta-table leakage

cases.scenario: basic presenter skid buffer holds one beat under downstream stall, then forwards it on ready-high
cases.primary_checks: skid buffer never doubles a beat; egress ordering preserved; catches skid duplicate

cases.scenario: basic presenter `EGRESS_DELAY = 3` pipeline matches ticket-to-first-beat latency in the absence of backpressure
cases.primary_checks: measured delay = 3 cycles on steady state; catches pipeline depth regression

cases.scenario: basic presenter retire_pending path fires exactly one retirement per frame at the end of PRESENTING
cases.primary_checks: one retire pulse observed per PRESENTING episode; catches double-retire

cases.scenario: basic presenter retire_pending contributes to FT_RD_HDR/SHD/HIT in a single cycle (atomic retirement)
cases.primary_checks: the three RD counters move together; catches staggered retirement

cases.scenario: basic presenter `resident_backpressure_hold` path is only entered when downstream ready is low for at least 2 consecutive cycles
cases.primary_checks: hold never engages on 1-cycle ready gap; catches hold fired on single-cycle gap

cases.scenario: basic presenter overwrite-drop decision is based on `circular_distance`/`circular_range_overlaps` and `frame_length_from_counts`
cases.primary_checks: on the healthy path the decision evaluates to 0 (no drop) for every frame; catches a false-positive drop

cases.scenario: basic presenter `new_frame_oversize` predicate does not fire on healthy frames (frame_length <= PAGE_RAM free slots)
cases.primary_checks: no oversize path taken; catches spurious oversize firing

cases.scenario: ticket field `TICKET_TS` at egress equals ingress `frame_ts_base + running_ts` reconstruction
cases.primary_checks: scoreboard matches on TICKET_TS; catches TS field swap

cases.scenario: ticket field `TICKET_BODY_SERIAL` is monotone increasing across the run and never repeats
cases.primary_checks: run-long monotonicity check; catches serial reset or dup

cases.scenario: ticket field `TICKET_SERIAL` is per-lane monotone and distinct from BODY_SERIAL
cases.primary_checks: per-lane serial stream checked; catches lane-mix of serial fields

cases.scenario: ticket field `TICKET_DT_TYPE` is preserved from ingress header and emitted at egress unchanged
